newsitem.title: USA: Philip Morris says "growth machine" advances.
newsitem.headline: Philip Morris says "growth machine" advances.

text.p: Philip Morris Cos Inc said Wednesday that its "growth machine" was "steaming ahead" after reporting a first-quarter profit of $0.73 a share against $0.63 for the same period a year ago.

"Although we will have to continue to contend with the strengthening of the U.S. dollar, the volume, market share and earnings fundamentals of our businesses remain powerful," it said. "The Philip Morris growth machine is steaming ahead," it added.
"Performance was robust despite the strengthening of the U.S. dollar against key foreign currencies," it said.
The company said its earnings growth was led by strong results from both its domestic and international tobacco businesses, as well as its North American food business.

Pretax operating income for the domestic tobacco business totaled $1.1 billion in the first quarter, up 10.6 percent from the same period a year ago, while it rose 15 percent to $1.3 billion for the international tobacco business, it said.
The North American food business saw its operating income up 10.1 percent to $743 million.
